set.body: Per decisions q-plan-coverage and generic-codec bead bd-01KYDZ5VDVS0E6SSKQJ8QH5EWJ. Provide a fixed core plan vocabulary plus typed extension registration. Generic P values are persistable only through conditional VersionedCodec instances with schema id/version; missing lookup or schema is explicit. HOLD THE RULE: plan parameters are typed domain values, never Map[String,String]. The acyclic plan/codec module seam is fixed by bd-01KYDZ7GGMYKTXYWNRR40Q8X9M before implementation.
